content: Nothing in excess; the golden middle path is the sanctuary of virtue.
author: Ancient Greek Proverbs
sourceWork: Meden agan (Μηδὲν ἄγαν) — The Delphic Maxims & Solon
explanation: Every virtue taken to extreme fanaticism becomes a destructive vice: courage becomes reckless foolhardiness; caution becomes cowardly paralysis; austerity becomes bitter cruelty. True greatness walks the balanced path between deficiency and wild excess.
practicalInsight: Examine one area of excess in your routine—work, screen time, eating, or anxiety—and gently pull the pendulum back to center.
reflectionPrompt: Where in your life has a good impulse been pushed to an unhealthy, exhausting extreme?
